sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 13475 of 2024
Petitioner :- Manoj Kumar Singh Chauhan

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Somendra Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Uma Nath Pandey
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Somendra Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Uma Nath Pandey, learned
counsel for the informant and Sri Kuldeep Singh Chauhan, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.
2.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the following prayer :-
"I. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 13.06.2024 lodged by respondent no.4 Manoj Kumar Singh Chauhan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34557903/
1 against the petitioner, which is registered as Case Crime No.0133 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Achhalda, District Auraiya (Annexure No.1 to this writ petition).
II. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents authorities not to take any coercive action against the petitioner in pursuance of the aforesaid First Information Report dated 13.06.2024 lodged by respondent no.4, which is registered as Case Crime No.0133 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Achhalda, District Auraiya during investigation in above case."
3. Submission of learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case to the effect he was given the part of the building for running institution from Class 1 to 8 by the Manager of the Institution and the present criminal prosecution has been lodged by filing an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. after about two years and the same is absolutely malafide in nature.

He next submitted that in fact prior to the present impugned first information report, the petitioner has filed a first information report dated 18.10.2023, registered as Case Crime No.303 of 2023, annexed as Annexure-8 to the writ petition wherein the informant herein Smt.
Chandrakant was one of the accused along with Harveer Singh Senger.

Submission is that therefore,
the said hearing is exemplary of malicious prosecution.

4. Per contra learned counsel for the informant submits is that the educational authority has clearly recorded a finding that the rent deeds so placed by the petitioner for getting the recognition for running the institution from Class-1 to 8 was based on a forged rent deed and it was found to be a forged document.
In respect of which he failed to produce any evidence before the education authority, therefore, the recognition was cancelled and the students were shifted to other nearby institution.
This fact is not in dispute.

Learned A.G.A. on the basis of instruction so received submitted that in respect of the application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C., a preliminary inquiry was conducted and allegations were found to be correct.
5. On perusal of first information report, we find that a cognizable offence is made out against the petitioner.

6. Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
